name: MiniMax H3 (Brutal self-hosted)
role: Same engine as h3, rendered on Brutal's own GPU instead of OpenRouter: people speaking with their own audio, image-to-video from one start frame

pricing.note: Not billed through OpenRouter: it runs on Brutal's GPU. The estimate shows 0; every real render still costs GPU time, so the confirmation rule still applies.

gotchas: The GPU is off when idle. The first render after a pause waits 4 to 7 minutes for it to start; it switches off after about 15 idle minutes. Launch related takes together.
Render time once the GPU runs: about 1.5 min for 5 s, 4.5 min for 10 s, 9 min for 15 s.
Only 5, 10 or 15 s. One start frame (--first-frame), no reference images, no last frame.
The pipeline was built for reels: expect a vertical 1080x1920 clip. Check the first render before planning a 16:9 piece around it.
'Try again later or use a hosted engine' means no GPU was available: use h3 (OpenRouter) for that take.
Same habits as h3: it keeps talking to the end and invents lettering on covers and screens.
